wanda-chat-welcometext: Salaan! Waxaan ahay Wanda, kaaliyahaaga AI.
wanda-chat-welcomedesc: I weydii wax kasta oo ku saabsan wikigaaga, waxaana isku dayi doonaa inaan ku caawiyo!
wanda-chat-pdftotext-error: Fadlan hubi in adeegga pdftotext la rakibay oo uu diyaar u yahay in la isticmaalo.
apihelp-wandachat-summary: U dir su'aal ama codsi chatbot-ka kordhinta Wanda
apihelp-wandachat-param-customprompt: Qoraalka tilmaanta ee la adeegsanayo halkii laga isticmaali lahaa tilmaanta caadiga ah
apihelp-wandachat-param-customprompttitl: Cinwaanka bogga wiki-ga ee loo adeegsanayo tusmada tilmaanta gaarka ah
apihelp-wandachat-param-temperature: Heerkulka muunad-qaadista ee loo isticmaalo soo saarista jawaabta (0.0 ilaa 1.0). Qiimayaasha sare waxay soo saaraan jawaabo kala duwanaansho badan leh.
apihelp-wandachat-param-maxtokens: Tirada ugu badan ee calaamadaha jawaabta
apihelp-wandachat-param-model: Qaabka luqadeed ee loo isticmaali doono soo saarista jawaabta
apihelp-wandachat-param-provider: Bixiyaha daruuraha ee loo isticmaali doono qaabka luqadeed
apihelp-wandachat-param-apiendpoint: Barta API-ga gaarka ah ee bixiyaha daruuraha
apihelp-wandachat-param-timeout: Waqtiga ugu badan ee sugitaanka codsiga API-ga, oo lagu cabbirayo ilbiriqsiyo
apihelp-wandachat-param-usepublicknowled: Haddii chatbot-ka loo oggolaanayo inuu isticmaalo aqoonta LLM-kiisa marka lagu daro macluumaadka wikiga (run/beenta)
apihelp-wandachat-param-skipesquery: Haddii laga boodi doono weydiinta Elasticsearch
wanda-api-error-temperature-invalid: Qiimaha heerkulku waa khalad. Fadlan bixi lambar u dhexeeya 0.0 iyo 1.0.
wanda-api-error-temperature-outofrange: Qiimaha heerkulku wuxuu ka baxsan yahay xadka. Fadlan bixi lambar u dhexeeya 0.0 iyo 1.0.
wanda-api-error-config-invalid: Adeegga wada sheekaysigu si sax ah looma habayn. Fadlan la xidhiidh maamule.
wanda-api-error-no-index: Ma helin macluumaad wiki oo khuseeya maadaama aan la helin tusmooyin. Fadlan hubi in nuxurka la sameeyay tusmo.
wanda-api-error-no-results: Ma helin macluumaad khuseeya mawduucaasi gudaha wiki-ga.
wanda-api-error-generation-failed: Waxaan hadda dhibaato kala kulmayaa soo saarista jawaab. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
wanda-api-error-token-limit: Jawaabta waa la soo gaabiyey xadka calaamadaha ($1 tokens) awgiis. Fadlan isku day inaad weydiiso su'aal ka sii gaar ah ama kordhi WandaLLMMaxTokens ee habaynta.
wanda-llm-response-nocontext: Ma haysto macluumaad ku filan oo ku jira macnaha guud ee wiki-ga si aan uga jawaabo taas.
wanda-toggle-public-knowledge-help: Marka la hawlgeliyo, kaaliyuhu waxa uu isticmaali karaa aqoontiisa guud marka lagu daro macnaha guud ee wiki-ga.
wanda-image-search-placeholder-text: Natiijooyinka raadintaada ayaa halkan ka soo muuqan doona
wanda-image-search-error: Khalad ayaa dhacay markii sawirrada la raadinayay. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
wanda-image-too-large: Sawirkani aad buu u weyn yahay. Cabbirka faylka ugu badan waa $1.
wanda-image-limit-reached: Ugu badnaan $1 sawir ayaa la lifaaqi karaa.
apihelp-wandachat-param-images: Liiska magacyada sawirrada ee lagu lifaaqayo oo lagu kala saaray calaamadda tuubada (|) (tusaale, 'File:Example.jpg|File:Image2.png')
apihelp-wandachat-param-conversationhist: Isku-dar JSON ah oo ku qoran fariimihii hore ee wada sheekaysiga, mid kasta oo leh meelaha 'role' iyo 'content'.
apihelp-wandachat-param-conversationmemo: In la xasuusto wada sheekaysigan iyo in kale
wanda-cargo-query-error: Lama soo ceshan karo xog habaysan oo ku saabsan su'aashan.
wanda-cargo-no-tables: Ma jiraan jadwallada Cargo ee diyaar u ah weydiinta.
wanda-cargo-query-failed: Weydiinta xogta habaysan ma soo celin wax natiijo ah.
wanda-cargo-multistep-max-reached: Waxaa la gaaray tirada ugu badan ee tallaabooyinka weydiinta Cargo ($1).
wanda-wikidata-query-error: Lama soo ceshan karo macluumaadka Wikidata ee su'aashan.
wanda-wikidata-no-results: Weydiinta Wikidata wax natiijo ah ma soo celin.
wanda-wikidata-multistep-max-reached: Waxaa la gaaray tirada ugu badan ee tallaabooyinka weydiinta Wikidata ($1).
wanda-smw-query-error: Lama soo ceshan karo xogta Semantic MediaWiki ee su’aashan.
wanda-smw-no-properties: Ma jiraan wax hanti Semantic MediaWiki ah oo loo heli karo weydiinta.
wanda-smw-query-failed: Weydiinta Semantic MediaWiki ma soo celin wax natiijo ah.
wanda-smw-multistep-max-reached: Waxaa la gaaray tirada ugu badan ee tallaabooyinka weydiinta Semantic MediaWiki ($1).
apihelp-wandachat-param-wikidataonly: Ka bood macnaha guud ee wiki-ga iyo Elasticsearch; uga jawaab adigoo isticmaalaya xogta Wikidata oo keliya
apihelp-wandachat-param-wikidatalang: Koodhka luqadda BCP-47 ee summadaha Wikidata (tusaale, 'en', 'de', 'fr'). Sida caadiga ah waxa uu isticmaalaa WandaWikidataLang ee la habeeyey.
apihelp-wandachat-param-sources: Liiska ilaha oo lagu kala saaray calaamadda dhuumaha oo loo isticmaalo soo-celinta (tusaale ahaan, 'wiki|wikidata|cargo|smw'). Qiimayaasha la taageerayo: wiki, wikidata, cargo, smw, externalwiki, publicknowledge, iyo magacyada ilo kasta oo RAG ah oo la habeeyay. Sida caadiga ah waa 'wiki'.
right-wanda-edit: Samee wax-ka-beddello ay AI-du ka caawisay adigoo isticmaalaya Wanda
action-wanda-edit: Samee wax-ka-beddello ay AI-du ka caawisay adigoo isticmaalaya Wanda
wanda-edit-preview-title: Dib u eeg wax ka beddelka la soo jeediyay
wanda-edit-no-change: Wanda wax isbeddel ah uma soo jeedin codsigaas.
wanda-edit-success: Waa la dhammeeyay! Bogga waa la cusboonaysiiyay:
wanda-edit-created: Waa la dhammeeyay! Bogga waa la abuuray:
wanda-edit-error: Wanda ma dhammaystiri karin wax ka beddelkaas. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
wanda-edit-notitle: Fadlan sheeg bogga aad rabto inaad wax ka beddesho.
wanda-edit-summary: Wax ka beddel uu AI ka caawiyay Wanda: $1
wanda-api-error-edit-disabled: Wax ka beddelka iyada oo loo marayo Wanda lagama hawlgelin wikigan.
wanda-api-error-edit-permission: Ma haysatid oggolaansho aad ku tafatirto bogagga adiga oo adeegsanaya Wanda.
wanda-api-error-edit-notitle: Cinwaan bog bartilmaameed sax ah ayaa loo baahan yahay si wax looga beddelo.
wanda-api-error-edit-failed: Wax ka beddelka lama kaydin karin.
apihelp-wandaedit-summary: Horudhac u eeg ama ku dabaq wax ka beddel uu AI ka caawiyay bog wiki ah adiga oo adeegsanaya kordhinta Wanda.
apihelp-wandaedit-param-message: Tilmaanta wax ka beddelka ee luuqadda dabiiciga ah (tusaale ahaan: "U beddel goobta lambarka taleefanka 555-1212").
apihelp-wandaedit-param-title: Cinwaanka bogga la tafatirayo. Haddii boggu aanu jirin, waa la abuuri doonaa.
apihelp-wandaedit-param-confirm: Marka ay tahay false (caadiga ah), soo celi kala-duwanaanshaha horudhaca ah adigoon kaydin. Marka ay tahay true, kaydi wikitext-ka la soo jeediyay.
apihelp-wandaedit-param-newtext: Wikitext-ka horudhac ahaan loo soo bandhigay ee la kaydinayo. Waa qasab marka confirm ay tahay true; haddii kale waa la iska indhatiraa.
apihelp-wandaedit-param-provider: Ka gudub adeeg-bixiyaha LLM ee loo habeeyey codsigan.
apihelp-wandaedit-param-model: Ka gudub moodeelka LLM ee loo habeeyey codsigan.
apihelp-wandaedit-param-apikey: Ka gudub furaha API-ga LLM ee loo habeeyey codsigan.
apihelp-wandaedit-param-apiendpoint: Ka gudub barta API-ga LLM ee loo habeeyey codsigan.
apihelp-wandaedit-param-timeout: Ka gudub wakhtiga xaddidan ee codsiga (ilbiriqsiyo) ee loo habeeyey codsigan.
apihelp-wandaedit-param-maxtokens: Ka gudub tirada ugu badan ee calaamadaha ee jawaabta LLM.
apihelp-wandaedit-example-preview: Horudhac u eeg wax-ka-beddelka goobta sanduuqa macluumaadka ee bogga 'John Smith'.
